title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 151–200 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: He wore a clean white shirt for the interview.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件乾淨的白襯衫去面試。

examples.en: This cotton shirt is breathable and comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 這件純棉襯衫透氣且穿起來很舒適。

examples.en: Don't forget to button up your shirt before going on stage.
examples.zh: 上台前別忘了把襯衫釦子扣好。

examples.en: I bought a cotton T-shirt at the night market.
examples.zh: 我在夜市買了一件純棉 T 恤。

examples.en: He likes wearing a plain graphic T-shirt with jeans.
examples.zh: 他喜歡穿素色圖案 T 恤搭配牛仔褲。

examples.en: Our class designed a custom T-shirt for sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班為運動會設計了專屬的班服 T 恤。

examples.en: These black pants fit me very well.
examples.zh: 這條黑長褲我穿起來非常合身。

examples.en: He rolled up his pants while walking along the beach.
examples.zh: 沿著海灘漫步時，他捲起了長褲褲管。

examples.en: You need to iron your dress pants before the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮開始前，你需要先熨燙你的西裝長褲。

examples.en: Blue jeans are comfortable for everyday wear.
examples.zh: 藍色牛仔褲非常適合日常穿著。

examples.en: She wore a pair of classic blue jeans with sneakers.
examples.zh: 她穿著一條經典的藍色牛仔褲搭配運動鞋。

examples.en: These denim jeans are very durable and never go out of style.
examples.zh: 這條丹寧牛仔褲非常耐穿且永不退流行。

examples.en: She wore a pretty red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的紅洋裝去參加聚會。

examples.en: Remember to dress warmly because it is cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，記得穿暖和一點。

examples.en: Everyone dressed up for the annual school graduation ball.
examples.zh: 大家盛裝打扮參加一年一度的學校畢業舞會。

examples.en: The school uniform includes a pleated skirt.
examples.zh: 學校制服包含一件百褶裙。

examples.en: She twirled around happily in her new floral skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿著新買的花裙開心地轉圈。

examples.en: Long skirts are popular among high school girls this summer.
examples.zh: 長裙今年夏天在女高中生之間非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Put on a warm coat; it is chilly outside.
examples.zh: 穿上一件保暖大衣，外面很涼。

examples.en: Hang your winter coat on the rack by the entrance.
examples.zh: 把你的冬天大衣掛在玄關旁的衣架上。

examples.en: The doctor put on his white laboratory coat.
examples.zh: 醫生穿上了他的白色實驗大衣。

examples.en: Do not forget to bring a light jacket.
examples.zh: 別忘了帶一件薄夾克。

examples.en: He zipped up his leather jacket as the wind grew stronger.
examples.zh: 隨著風勢變強，他拉上了皮夾克的拉鍊。

examples.en: It was cool in the evening, so I wore a denim jacket.
examples.zh: 傍晚天氣轉涼，所以我穿了一件牛仔夾克。

examples.en: My grandmother knitted a warm sweater for me.
examples.zh: 我奶奶為我織了一件溫暖的毛衣。

examples.en: This woolen sweater feels soft and keeps me warm in winter.
examples.zh: 這件羊毛毛衣觸感柔軟，讓我在冬天保持溫暖。

examples.en: Pull on a cozy sweater when sitting by the campfire.
examples.zh: 坐在營火旁時套上一件舒適的毛衣。

examples.en: Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
examples.zh: 進屋前請脫鞋。

examples.en: I need a pair of supportive running shoes for track practice.
examples.zh: 田徑練習時我需要一雙支撐良好的跑步鞋。

examples.en: Make sure your shoes are tied tightly before the race.
examples.zh: 比賽前請確保你的鞋帶已繫緊。

examples.en: Wear thick socks to keep your feet warm.
examples.zh: 穿厚襪子能讓雙腳保持保暖。

examples.en: I bought three pairs of white cotton socks at the department store.
examples.zh: 我在百貨公司買了三雙白色純棉襪。

examples.en: He couldn't find a matching pair of clean socks this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上找不到一雙配對整齊的乾淨襪子。

examples.en: He wore a straw hat to protect from the sun.
examples.zh: 他戴了一頂草帽來防曬。

examples.en: Take off your hat when you enter the church.
examples.zh: 進入教堂時請脫下帽子。

examples.en: The colorful knit hat kept her ears warm during the hike.
examples.zh: 健行時，這頂色彩繽紛的針織帽保護她的雙耳免受風寒。

examples.en: Many baseball fans wear team caps.
examples.zh: 許多棒球迷都會戴球隊的棒球帽。

examples.en: Twist the bottle cap tightly to avoid leaking water.
examples.zh: 旋緊瓶蓋以防漏水。

examples.en: He pulled his black baseball cap down low over his forehead.
examples.zh: 他把黑色的棒球帽壓低到額頭前。

examples.en: Students must wear uniforms to school.
examples.zh: 學生上學必須穿制服。

examples.en: She always wears glasses when working on the computer.
examples.zh: 她在用電腦時總是戴著眼鏡。

examples.en: What are you planning to wear to the birthday party?
examples.zh: 你打算穿什麼去參加生日派對？

examples.en: Put on your coat before you go out.
examples.zh: 出門前穿上你的大衣。

examples.en: He put on his running shoes and headed out for a jog.
examples.zh: 他穿上慢跑鞋，出門去慢跑。

examples.en: Put on a smile and be confident during the presentation.
examples.zh: 簡報時面帶微笑並展現自信。

examples.en: Please take off your hat inside the classroom.
examples.zh: 在教室裡請把帽子脫掉。

examples.en: The flight will take off from the runway in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 航班將在十分鐘內由跑道起飛。

examples.en: He took off his wet jacket as soon as he got home.
examples.zh: 他一回到家就立刻脫下了濕透的夾克。

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個妹妹。

examples.en: Please take one step forward so everyone fits into the frame.
examples.zh: 請向前一步，讓大家都能入鏡。

examples.en: Only one person at a time can use the elevator.
examples.zh: 電梯一次只能容納一人使用。

examples.en: There are two cats resting on the sofa.
examples.zh: 有兩隻貓正在沙發上休息。

examples.en: The train journey will take about two hours.
examples.zh: 火車車程大約需要兩小時。

examples.en: We ordered two cups of bubble milk tea to share.
examples.zh: 我們點了兩杯珍珠奶茶一起分享。

examples.en: We have three English classes every week.
examples.zh: 我們每週有三堂英文課。

examples.en: The traffic light displayed three distinct colors: red, yellow, and green.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈顯示了三種明顯的顏色：紅、黃、綠。

examples.en: Divide the cake into three equal pieces for everyone.
examples.zh: 把蛋糕切成均等的三塊分給每個人。

examples.en: A square has four equal sides.
examples.zh: 正方形有四條等長的邊。

examples.en: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, fall, and winter.
examples.zh: 一年有四季：春、夏、秋、冬。

examples.en: Four students worked together on the science experiment.
examples.zh: 四名學生分工合作完成自然科學實驗。

examples.en: High five! You did a wonderful job.
examples.zh: 擊掌！你做得太棒了。

examples.en: The convenience store is just a five-minute walk from here.
examples.zh: 便利商店距離這裡步行只要五分鐘。

examples.en: A human hand has five fingers including the thumb.
examples.zh: 人手包括拇指在內共有五隻手指。

examples.en: The store opens at six o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 這家店每天早上六點開門。

examples.en: An insect typically has six legs.
examples.zh: 昆蟲通常有六隻腳。

examples.en: We reserved a dinner table for six people at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在餐廳預訂了一張六人晚餐桌。

examples.en: 7-Eleven is a very popular convenience store in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 7-Eleven 是台灣非常受歡迎的便利商店。

examples.en: There are seven days in every week.
examples.zh: 每個星期有七天。

examples.en: Rainbows are formed with seven vibrant colors in the sky.
examples.zh: 彩虹是由天空中七種鮮豔的色彩所組成。

examples.en: School starts at eight in the morning.
examples.zh: 學校在早上八點開始上課。

examples.en: An octopus has eight flexible arms called tentacles.
examples.zh: 章魚有八隻靈活的手腕，稱為觸手。

examples.en: She tries to sleep eight full hours every night.
examples.zh: 她每晚盡量睡滿整整八個小時。

examples.en: The package arrived at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 包裹在九點整準時送達。

examples.en: Cats are said to have nine lives in folklore.
examples.zh: 民間傳說中貓咪有九條命。

examples.en: The morning bell rings at nine o'clock for the first lecture.
examples.zh: 第一節課的早晨鐘聲在九點整響起。

examples.en: Count from one to ten slowly.
examples.zh: 請從一慢慢數到十。

examples.en: It took only ten minutes to solve the math puzzle.
examples.zh: 解開這道數學謎題只花了十分鐘。

examples.en: She was among the top ten students in the grade.
examples.zh: 她名列年級前十名優秀學生之中。

examples.en: This meal costs one hundred NT dollars.
examples.zh: 這頓飯花費新台幣一百元。

examples.en: Hundreds of fans waited outside the concert hall.
examples.zh: 數百名歌迷在音樂廳外守候。

examples.en: There are one hundred centimeters in one meter.
examples.zh: 一公尺等於一百公分。

examples.en: Over five thousand runners joined the marathon.
examples.zh: 超過五千名跑者參加了馬拉松。

examples.en: This historic temple has stood for more than a thousand years.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古廟已經屹立了一千多年。

examples.en: Thousands of migratory birds visit the wetlands every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天都有數千隻候鳥造訪這片濕地。

examples.en: Safety always comes first.
examples.zh: 安全永遠排在第一位。

examples.en: This is my very first time visiting Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 這是我第一次造訪日月潭。

examples.en: She won first prize in the national speech competition.
examples.zh: 她在全國演講比賽中勇奪第一名。

examples.en: Wait for a second, please.
examples.zh: 請稍等一秒鐘。

examples.en: The library is located on the second floor of the building.
examples.zh: 圖書館位於這棟大樓的二樓。

examples.en: He finished the race in second place.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中獲得第二名。

examples.en: Our apartment is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓在三樓。

examples.en: Tuesday is the third day of the work week.
examples.zh: 星期二是工作週的第三天。

examples.en: One third of the students voted in favor of the new proposal.
examples.zh: 三分之一的學生投票贊成這項新提案。

examples.en: Can I have your phone number?
examples.zh: 能給我你的電話號碼嗎？

examples.en: Write the correct number in the blank space provided.
examples.zh: 在提供的空白處填入正確的數字。

examples.en: A large number of tourists visit Taipei 101 every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有大量遊客參觀台北 101。

examples.en: There are many trees in the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡有許多樹木。

examples.en: How many students are attending the summer workshop?
examples.zh: 有多少位學生會參加暑期工作坊？

examples.en: Many people prefer to read digital books nowadays.
examples.zh: 現今許多人偏好閱讀電子書。

examples.en: How much does this milk tea cost?
examples.zh: 這杯奶茶多少錢？

examples.en: Thank you very much for your kind assistance.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你親切的協助。

examples.en: There isn't much time left before the exam begins.
examples.zh: 距離考試開始所剩時間不多了。

examples.en: He has a few good friends in his hometown.
examples.zh: 他在家鄉有幾位好朋友。

examples.en: Very few people know about this hidden mountain trail.
examples.zh: 極少數人知道這條隱密的山間小徑。

examples.en: We arrived at the station a few minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 我們在發車前幾分鐘抵達了車站。

examples.en: Add a little sugar to the coffee.
examples.zh: 在咖啡裡加一點點糖。

examples.en: A little boy was feeding the ducks by the pond.
examples.zh: 一個小男孩正在池塘邊餵鴨子。

examples.en: She had little patience for rude behavior.
examples.zh: 她對無禮的行為幾乎毫無耐心。

examples.en: Would you like some hot tea?
examples.zh: 你想要來點熱茶嗎？

examples.en: Some students prefer to study in the quiet library.
examples.zh: 有些學生偏好在安靜的圖書館唸書。

examples.en: Can you lend me some coins for the vending machine?
examples.zh: 你能借我一些零錢投販賣機嗎？

examples.en: Do you have any questions about the lesson?
examples.zh: 你對這堂課有任何疑問嗎？

examples.en: You can call me any time if you need help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，隨時都可以打電話給我。

examples.en: I didn't see any cars on the quiet country road.
examples.zh: 在寧靜的鄉間小路上我沒看到任何車輛。

examples.en: All students should listen to the teacher.
examples.zh: 所有學生都應該聽老師講課。

examples.en: We played soccer in the rain all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在雨中踢足球。

examples.en: All of us are excited about the upcoming school field trip.
examples.zh: 我們所有人都對即將到來的校外教學感到興奮。

examples.en: The weather is pleasant in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的天氣很宜人。

examples.en: Check the weather forecast before going hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 去山區健行前請務必查看天氣預報。

examples.en: Hot and humid weather is typical during summer in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 炎熱潮濕的天氣是台灣夏天的典型特徵。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zh: 太陽從東方升起。

examples.en: Wearing sunglasses protects your eyes from the bright sun.
examples.zh: 戴太陽眼鏡可以保護眼睛免受強烈陽光傷害。

examples.en: The flowers blossomed happily under the morning sun.
examples.zh: 花兒在晨光朝陽下燦爛綻放。

examples.en: We had a picnic on a sunny Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們在一個陽光明媚的週日野餐。

examples.en: It was a bright and sunny morning without a cloud in sight.
examples.zh: 那是一個晴朗萬里的早晨，天空中萬里無雲。

examples.en: Sunny days always lift people's spirits and energy.
examples.zh: 陽光明媚的日子總能讓人精神煥發、充滿活力。

examples.en: It started to rain in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午開始下雨了。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused flash flooding on some low-lying streets.
examples.zh: 豪大雨導致部分低窪街道發生積水。

examples.en: Plants grow quickly after receiving fresh spring rain.
examples.zh: 植物在接受了春雨滋潤後迅速生長。

examples.en: Keelung is famous for its rainy days.
examples.zh: 基隆以多雨的天氣聞名。

examples.en: I enjoy staying indoors with a good book on rainy afternoons.
examples.zh: 在多雨的午後，我喜歡待在室內讀一本好書。

examples.en: Drivers should slow down and maintain extra distance on rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天開車時駕駛人應減速慢行並保持安全車距。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.zh: 帶把雨傘以防下雨。

examples.en: She opened her colorful umbrella when raindrops began to fall.
examples.zh: 雨滴開始落下時，她撐開了色彩繽紛的雨傘。

examples.en: I accidentally left my folding umbrella on the MRT train.
examples.zh: 我不小心把折疊傘遺留在捷運列車上了。

examples.en: A strong wind blew my hat away.
examples.zh: 一陣強風吹走了我的帽子。

examples.en: A refreshing cool wind blew in from the sea.
examples.zh: 一陣清涼爽朗的微風從海面上吹拂而來。

examples.en: Wind turbines generate renewable energy along the western coast.
examples.zh: 風力發電機在西部海岸生產再生能源。

examples.en: Hsinchu is known as the windy city.
examples.zh: 新竹被稱為風城。

examples.en: It is too windy today to go sailing on the lake.
examples.zh: 今天風太大了，不適合在湖面上泛舟。

examples.en: The windy weather made flying a kite easy and fun.
examples.zh: 起風的天氣讓放風箏變得輕鬆又有趣。

examples.en: White clouds are floating across the sky.
examples.zh: 白雲在天空中飄浮。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered quickly before the summer storm.
examples.zh: 夏日暴風雨來臨前，烏雲迅速聚攏。

examples.en: You can store your documents and photos securely in the cloud.
examples.zh: 你可以將文件與相片安全地儲存在雲端。

examples.en: It is cloudy today, but it won't rain.
examples.zh: 今天多雲，但不會下雨。

examples.en: The weather was cool and cloudy during our mountain hike.
examples.zh: 我們登山健行期間的天氣涼爽且多雲。

examples.en: Photography is often softer and more flattering on cloudy days.
examples.zh: 在陰天拍照時光線通常更加柔和、呈現效果更佳。

examples.en: It rarely snows in low altitude areas of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣低海拔地區很少下雪。

examples.en: Mount Hehuan is covered in thick snow during cold winters.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬日裡，合歡山覆蓋著厚厚的白雪。

examples.en: Children were delighted to build a snowman in the fresh snow.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在新下的白雪中開心地堆起雪人。
